news.title: Chandigarh housing board's regularisation push hits resistance within administration
news.para: Chandigarh administration faces challenges over the regularization of need-based alterations in CHB flats. Senior officials caution that additional concessions could validate illegal constructions and jeopardize public safety. Recommendations from the urban planning department underscore the dangers of increased building heights, while a new survey uncovers widespread violations of building regulations. These issues could significantly affect future urban planning and residential policies.

news.title: Clearance certificates must before making project estimates in Gurugram
news.para: MCG has implemented new rules requiring site clearance certificates before starting development projects to prevent disputes. The engineering wing will now survey all proposed project sites for encroachments and disputes. Additional measures include penalties for contractors who fail to meet project timelines or quality standards. A priority will be given to development works suggested by elected representatives and resident welfare associations.

news.title: Phase-II land pooling for Amaravati gains ground, over 8,000 acres secured in eight villages
news.para: The Amaravati land pooling initiative is entering its second phase, with an impressive 8,180 acres already acquired by the CRDA. Officials are actively engaging with farmers to resolve their issues and streamline the process. By aiming for an 85% participation rate, they hope to launch master planning and crucial infrastructure upgrades. Nevertheless, some landowners remain hesitant, seeking reassurances about compensation and plots.

news.title: MahaRERA gives flat  allottees in Mihan 15 days to pay dues or risk termination
news.para: MahaRERA has ordered two flat allottees in the Mihan area to pay outstanding dues within 15 days. The authority stated that failure to pay will result in the termination of their agreements. The allottees previously made partial payments but did not respond to repeated demands. MahaRERA emphasized the importance of fulfilling their financial obligations per real estate law.

news.title: NAREDCO Haryana seek longer timelines for projects, cite GRAP curbs
news.para: NAREDCO Haryana has put forth 13 suggestions to HRera focused on enhancing the efficiency of project registration and approval protocols. These recommendations include proposals for automatic extensions to construction bans and revisions to fees imposed on developers. The organization highlights how pollution-related regulations affect construction schedules and labor availability. Additionally, NAREDCO seeks a streamlined verification process for project approvals and a consolidated online fee system.

news.title: A year after SC order, registries resume at Supertech's Supernova in Noida
news.para: Flat registrations at Supertech's Supernova project in Noida have finally resumed following a nearly six-year halt. The initial step in resolving a considerable backlog of 497 flats has been taken with the registration of five apartments. Due to previous disputes over unpaid dues, buyers have long awaited clarity on their property rights.

news.title: Mumbai buyers pay EMIs for undelivered flat; Riddhi Sidhi Corporation ordered to pay ₹83 lakh
news.para: A Mumbai builder has been directed to refund Rs 83.56 lakh to flat buyers due to significant delays. The commission found that construction completion was only about 50% to 60% at the time of the complaint. Flat buyers had not received possession as stipulated in their agreement from February 2019. The buyers faced financial hardships, including incorrect EMI payments that began in August 2020.

news.title: Bharati Builders case: 771 buyers await ₹148 crore as ED widens asset seizure
news.para: The Enforcement Directorate has seized assets worth ₹8.3 crore as part of the Bharati Builders money laundering case, which raises the total seized value to ₹26.3 crore. The investigation has revealed that 771 homeowners are owed a whopping ₹147.8 crore, with promoters not disclosing crucial changes in land ownership until this year. The attached assets encompass bank accounts, machinery, and land linked to alleged shell firms.

news.title: NBCC says unusually low bids led it to scrap bid for premium flats
news.para: After receiving bids that fell short of financial expectations, NBCC has elected to cancel the auction for residential units in Sarojini Nagar. The public sector entity notified prospective buyers, who were previously led to believe they held the highest bids, that a fresh auction is slated for November 30. This decision aligns with NBCC's goal to secure maximum sale value for essential redevelopment projects.

news.title: Bank of England warns over rising mortgage costs
news.para: Millions of Britons will see their mortgage payments climb, leaving them further exposed to economic shocks, the Bank of England warned Thursday, after raising its own borrowing costs to combat inflation. Around 6.5 million British borrowers face higher monthly mortgage payments by the end of 2029, according to the report on financial stability.

news.title: ED attaches flats, land worth ₹702.70-crore in money-laundering case linking Ozone group
news.para: The Enforcement Directorate has recently attached properties exceeding Rs 702.70 crore tied to a money-laundering probe involving Ozone Urbana Infra Developers Pvt Ltd and associated firms. Following several FIRs, the case highlights allegations of deceit and unlawful activities, focusing on unfulfilled apartment deliveries and the lack of refunds for homebuyers, resulting in an impressive total of Rs 1,305.11 crores in claimed fraud.

news.title: Ashiana-Arihant JV acquires 9.57-acre Chennai land; Concorde signs North Bengaluru JDA
news.para: Kairav Developers is gearing up to launch an exciting senior living project near Chennai, and they anticipate making a whopping ₹1,100 crore from it! Meanwhile, Concorde has just struck a Joint Development Agreement for a new residential project in North Bengaluru, which is expected to bring in a gross development value of ₹450 crore.

news.title: SC orders HDFC, ICICI bank to grant prosecution sanction in subvention fraud cases
news.para: The Supreme Court has directed HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Sammaan Capital, and PNB Housing Finance to grant unconditional prosecution sanctions. This order relates to alleged frauds arising from subvention schemes involving homebuyers and builders. The CBI reported difficulties securing necessary prosecution sanctions, particularly from HDFC Bank. The court emphasized that banking authorities must fulfill their duty to grant these sanctions promptly.

news.title: Enforcement directorate attaches assets worth over ₹545 crore of Gurugram's Vatika Group
news.para: The Enforcement Directorate has frozen assets worth Rs 545 crore associated with the promoters of the Vatika Group. The assets include a lavish farmhouse in south Delhi linked to Kanchan Bhalla. Anil Bhalla and Gautam Bhalla have been in judicial custody since their arrest in September.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh RERA takes disciplinary action against 17 employees
news.para: Uttar Pradesh RERA's action covers three junior engineers, two assistant accountants, eight computer operators and four other staff members. The authority said the disciplinary proceedings were carried out separately at different points in time.

news.title: The Phoenix Mills elevates its Kurla office district through a comprehensive campus transformation
news.para: The Phoenix Mills Ltd. is on a mission to reinvent its renowned office district in Kurla over an 18-month span. The transformation will involve a thoughtful redesign of architecture and communal spaces, enhancing the atmosphere for businesses and their employees alike. With improved facades and safer pedestrian pathways, the project signifies a strong commitment to fostering commercial growth in the region.

news.title: Mumbai: BMC’s move to hand over Bandra Reclamation plots to SRA project’s developer sparks controversy
news.para: A proposal by BMC to hand over public plots in Bandra Reclamation to a private developer has raised concerns. Citizens and public representatives are questioning the necessity of this move. Corporator Karen D’Mello has urged the cancellation of the proposal, citing public access issues. Former corporator Asif Zakaria has challenged the legality of BMC's actions regarding open spaces.

news.title: Kolkata: 100 real estate projects stuck as approvals stall in growth belt of Salt Lake-Sector V-New Town
news.para: The approval process for real estate developments in Bidhannagar Municipal Corporation, New Town Kolkata Development Authority, and Nabadiganta Industrial Township Authority has hit a standstill. Nearly 100 projects, totaling 15 million square feet and involving an investment of around Rs 7,500 crore, are currently stalled, causing difficulties for developers as well as workers, contractors, and related businesses.

news.title: Now, promoters’ track record on Gujarat RERA portal
news.para: The Gujarat Real Estate Regulatory Authority has launched an innovative section on its website specifically designed for homebuyers. This new feature showcases the past performances of project promoters in Gujarat, allowing users to easily access crucial information such as project documents, timelines for completion, and any complaints associated with previous projects.

news.title: Telangana RERA gives ELV Projects six months to finish work on Adibatla flats
news.para: The Telangana Real Estate Regulatory Authority has mandated that ELV Projects rectify outstanding amenities within six months. Residents of ELV Cosmopolis have raised concerns over frequent power outages and insufficient water supply despite their hefty payments. RERA has directed the developer to guarantee steady electricity and complete essential facilities. Complaints regarding hostel operations in certain apartments fell outside the authority's scope. Failure to comply will incur penalties for ELV Projects.
